chapters.title: PnP, Agentic AI and GitHub Copilot

takeaways: PnP PowerShell and PnP .NET are community-maintained, open-source tools that fill gaps in Microsoft's own SharePoint and Graph tooling, including fluent APIs and robust throttling handling, but they are not supported by Microsoft.
Development focus is shifting from SharePoint toward Teams apps and Copilot extensibility, with PnP exploring an MCP server and agent skills for AI-driven workflows.
AI and GitHub Copilot accelerate development, but developers still need language fundamentals, least-privilege permissions and governance to stay responsible for the code they ship.
hook: Microsoft 365 development is moving from SharePoint toward Teams, Copilot extensibility and agentic AI. In this interview, five-time MVP and PnP maintainer Gautam Sheth explains what PnP PowerShell and PnP .NET solve, how open source is maintained and how GitHub Copilot changes daily development. A practical episode for Microsoft 365 developers and admins who automate with PnP and AI.
